stage: after development-only threshold selection (selected.json), before the final audit ran
reason: The features include hour_sin/hour_cos, and 4-hour volatility has a strong intraday session pattern. Beating persistence (which is wrong at every session change) could therefore reflect only clock knowledge a trader already has.

added_baselines.clock: Per UTC hour of day, the high-volatility rate in the training period (2008-2022, same sampled rows); predict high when that rate is >= 0.5; hours unseen in training fall back to the training prevalence
added_baselines.simple_logistic_info_only: Logistic regression (median impute, standardize, C=0.1) on 24 hour-of-day indicators plus rv_ratio_4 and rv_ratio_24, trained on the same rows; reported for information, not a pass/fail criterion

added_success_criterion: Equal-weighted across pairs, the model's balanced accuracy must also exceed the clock baseline's balanced accuracy. All original criteria still apply.
unchanged: Selection, threshold, training split, test split and all other criteria
